subject: environmental-science
title: Pollution & Acid Rain: Reducing Pollution
welcome_lead: Many small changes add up to big drops in pollution.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: reducing pollution, choices.
final_note: Cleaner choices save money and lives.

concepts.def: Energy from sources that don't run out.
Buses, trains and trams shared by many.
Car powered by batteries, no exhaust.
Using something again instead of binning it.
Making new items from old materials.
Can carry on without hurting the planet.

walkthroughs.body_html: Swap fossil fuels for renewable energy — solar, wind, hydro. Cleaner power means cleaner air for everyone.
Walk, cycle, take a bus or train. Public transport and electric cars cut emissions massively.
Reduce what you buy. Reuse and recycle. Less waste means less pollution and lower demand for raw materials.
